entry.title: Solana Launches Onchain Governance With Stake-Weighted Voting for Validators
entry.summary: Solana Foundation says onchain governance is now live, letting validators with at least 100,000 SOL delegated open proposals that go to a stake-weighted vote once they clear 15% cluster support.

entry.title: Venice Raises $65M Series A at $1B Valuation Led by Dragonfly
entry.summary: Erik Voorhees' privacy-first AI platform Venice landed a $65 million Series A at a $1 billion equity valuation, its first outside capital, after hitting profitability in Q1.

entry.title: Avalanche Treasury Corp Stock Crashes 93%, Warns SEC It May Not Survive the Year
entry.summary: Avalanche Treasury Corp told the SEC its ability to continue as a going concern is in doubt after its Nasdaq-listed stock lost 93% of its value in a month, with its AVAX position now worth less than half of what it paid.

entry.title: Supreme Court Overturns Humphrey's Executor, Clearing Trump to Fire SEC and CFTC Commissioners
entry.summary: The Supreme Court's 6-3 ruling in Trump v. Slaughter overturns a 91-year-old precedent shielding independent agency commissioners from at-will removal, with direct implications for SEC and CFTC leadership as the CLARITY Act nears a floor vote.

entry.title: dYdX Launches Arcus, a DEX Pairing Stock Tokens With Perpetuals on Robinhood Chain
entry.summary: dYdX Labs founder Antonio Juliano launched Arcus, a new DEX combining tokenized stock trading with perpetual futures, built jointly with Robinhood Crypto on Robinhood Chain.

entry.title: Robinhood Launches Robinhood Chain Mainnet, Adds Stock Tokens, Onchain Lending, and Agentic Crypto Trading

entry.title: SEC Opens 60-Day Comment Period on 'Novel' ETF Rules as Prediction Market Funds Pile Up
entry.summary: The SEC published a formal request for comment on 'Novel ETFs' covering crypto-asset and prediction-market funds, following Chair Paul Atkins' May statement pausing launches for over two dozen pending applications.

entry.title: World Launches Onchain Prediction Market on Solana Through Phantom

entry.title: Chinese Exile Miles Guo Sentenced to 30 Years for $1B Crypto Fraud Scheme
